facts.intro: A Costa Rica beach condo, ready to live in or rent out.
list: No agency fees. Sold by owner.
South Beach Jacó, the quiet end of the bay
Active vacation rental. Figures on request.

highlights.h2: Four reasons buyers fall for it
items: A quiet beach, a calm sea
The south end of Playa Jacó curves into a bay. The water is gentler here, and the beach is rarely crowded.
A small-scale condominium with just 21 homes. Shared spaces stay calm.
A very relaxed residential street, away from the bar strip. The centre of Jacó is minutes away.
An active vacation rental with a record of guest reviews. Rental income figures on request.

view.h2: The sea is in every room you use most
view.p1: The living room opens through a wall of sliding glass to a private terrace. Palms, then water, then sky.
view.p2: You see the waves from the sofa. In the evening the light turns gold, then pink, and the whole room takes on the colour.

home.h2: Open plan, from the stove to the sea
home.p: One open space runs from the kitchen to the terrace. A quartz island with bar stools. Stainless steel appliances and a hand-painted tile backsplash. A stacked washer and dryer sit in their own corner.
home.caption: Fully furnished. Bring a suitcase.

rooms.intro: One bedroom faces the ocean, one faces the green hills. Both are quiet, cool and fully made up.
cards: Wake to the sea through a full-height sliding door. The door opens straight onto the terrace.
Two twin beds and a desk, with a view into the trees. Good for children, friends or a home office.
Walk-in rain showers and clean, simple finishes. Straight from the beach to a proper rinse.

terrace.h2: A front-row seat on the Pacific
terrace.line: Morning coffee, evening light. Scarlet macaws fly past most days.

building.p: Sunset Boulevard is an intimate condominium with just 21 homes. There is a pool with a stone waterfall wall, a covered lounge beside it, an elevator and covered parking. Shared spaces stay quiet and well kept.

rooftop.line: The shared rooftop looks over the whole bay. Bring a drink and stay until dark.

included.intro: Everything in the home is included in the sale.
items: From the living room, main bedroom and terrace

location.h2: South Beach Jacó: quiet, and close to everything
location.p1: The condo sits at the south end of Playa Jacó, where the beach curves into a bay. The water is calmer here. The street is quiet and relaxed.
location.p2: The centre of Jacó, with its restaurants, shops and supermarkets, is just minutes away. The bar strip stays out of earshot.
points: Surf beach, about 10 min by car
National park, about 1 h 15 min south

income.h2: Already working as a vacation rental
income.p: Unit 405 rents on Airbnb today, with a record of guest reviews. Keep it as an income property, live in it, or both.
